summary: Vanillaware and Atlus's 2024 tactical RPG about reclaiming Fevrith from the Zenoiran Empire.

entries.title: Unicorn Overlord

emulation.notes: Native PS5 or Xbox Series X/S hardware is preferred.

primary.why: Unicorn Overlord released on Switch, PS4, PS5, and Xbox Series X/S with no PC release; PS5 is a clean highest-fidelity current-gen console route.
primary.how_to_play: Play the fully patched PS5 release. Xbox Series X/S is an equivalent current-gen alternative; Switch is best only for portability.

entries.remaster_caveats: No PC release is documented; keep the game patched for bug fixes and quality-of-life updates.
